error.headline: The site isn't responding right now
error.body: You're online, but {trackName} didn't load. Wait a moment and try again.
offline.headline: You're offline
offline.body: Connect to Wi-Fi or mobile data to continue.
switch.title: Switch tracks?
switch.body: The current window will close. Your progress in {currentTrackName} stays put — it'll be waiting when you come back.
webPreview.explainer: This browser preview can't load the live site. Inside the app, this screen opens in full.
perm.mic.title: Allow microphone access?
perm.mic.body: Needed to record your voice in speaking practice. The recording stays on your device.
perm.notif.title: Turn on reminders?
perm.notif.body: We'll send a short reminder for your practice. You can turn it off any time.
login.headline: Sign in to {trackName}
login.email.label: Email
login.password.label: Password
login.google.banner: Signed up with Google before? You don't have a password yet. Use 'Forgot password' to set one for email sign-in.
login.google.error: Couldn't sign in with Google. Please try again.
login.ielts.notReady: IELTS sign-in is opening soon. For now, pick CEFR or go straight to ieltslevel.uz.
auth.err.invalid_credentials: Wrong email or password. If you signed up via Google on the website, you have no password yet — tap "Forgot password?" to set one.
auth.err.email_not_confirmed: Email not confirmed yet. Check your inbox.
auth.err.rate_limit: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.
auth.err.network: No internet connection. Check your network and try again.
onboarding.s1.title: English, in one place
onboarding.s1.body: CEFR from the ground up to C1. Full IELTS exam prep. Both tracks in one app.
onboarding.s2.title: You pick the track
onboarding.s2.body: Each track has its own coach, its own exercises, its own results. You can switch later.
onboarding.s3.title: Practice. Feedback. Growth.
onboarding.s3.body: Short practice every day — AI feedback — real preparation.
